rowHint: Hide what you never use and move entries up or down within their group.
listHint: Opens when you right-click next to the files.
resetTip: Shows every entry again, in the usual order.
othersHintWindows: Everything CannonCommander has seen in the Windows menu so far. What you hide is gone the next time it opens.
othersHintLinux: Actions from Dolphin, Nemo, Nautilus and Thunar that CannonCommander has offered so far. What you hide is gone the next time it opens.
noneSeenTip: Open “Show more options” once and the entries will show up here.
propsWindowsTip: Security, details and previous versions in the Windows dialog.
propsSystemTip: Opens the dialog of your desktop's file manager.
iconsTip: Shows your system's icons throughout the list. Programs and shortcuts show their own icon even with this off.
